_about: Hand verdicts (2026-11-15) for every finding the bench run results/replay-pre.json produced, made by reading the independent browser read (evidence/) and, where the crawl's claim was about raw markup, the crawl's own saved HTML (cache/). T = what the client would read is true. F = false or materially overstated (a line with a false example is false). A finding id not listed for a site was not produced for it. Kept as the fixed answer key: a later run's finding is scored against it; a finding it has never seen is reported as unlabelled, never as right. The third value is the finding text the verdict was given for: when a later run says something different, the scorer reports it as changed (to be re-labelled), never reuses the old verdict.
